# GUT bundled font notices

GUT 9.7.1 code is MIT licensed. Its bundled fonts have separate SIL Open Font License 1.1 terms. The unchanged upstream snapshot includes Anonymous Pro, Courier Prime, Lobster Two and Source Code Pro font resources; the corresponding official notices are retained here.

`tools/gut.lock.json` records each notice's source and SHA256. `tools/check_gut.py --verify-only` checks these bytes together with all 259 pinned GUT files. These are development-only dependencies and are excluded from the selected playable export. No font has been modified or substituted into the player interface.
